question: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.25
details.actual_sql:
WITH customer_spend AS (
  SELECT
    t.customer_id,
    c.currency,
    SUM(t.amount * t.price) AS total_spend,
    SUM(t.amount)           AS total_items,
    SUM(t.amount * t.price) / NULLIF(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS avg_price_per_item
  FROM transactions_1k t
  JOIN customers c
    ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
  GROUP BY t.customer_id, c.currency
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    cs.*,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spend DESC) AS spend_rank
  FROM customer_spend cs
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  currency,
  total_spend,
  total_items,
  avg_price_per_item
FROM ranked
WHERE spend_rank = 1
ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
details.gold_sql: SELECT T2.customer_id, SUM(T2.price / NULLIF(T2.amount, 0)), T1.currency FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T2.customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM yearmonth ORDER BY consumption DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T2.customer_id, T1.currency
